source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes a HIB URI, disables TLS, selects three fields and omits the Master-required exact IPMI comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires HIB member/device mapping, complete cross-source fields and no-write controls.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 957/2291 accepts the partial command without defining which platform interconnect board HIB names.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Front-panel and mainboard FRUs are distinct hardware identities and cannot provide HIB evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify the intended HIB board is represented by FRU_HIB and its complete inventory matches among WebUI, exact Redfish member, exact read-only IPMI FRU and Project hardware record.
original_method: Resolve HIB's physical instance and management mappings, collect complete protected read-only records and UI detail, normalize vendor fields and compare them without clearing logs or mutating FRU/BMC state.
manual_activity: The platform owner identifies the HIB instance, its API/IPMI objects and expected FRU content; automated collection follows, while UI discrepancies and the verdict remain engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Perform reads only and never edit FRU, reset BMC or reboot.
Do not assume a friendly HIB URI or default IPMI device.
Use trusted transport and protect credentials/serials.
Stop on ambiguous HIB instance or unresolved source disagreement without retry-by-guess.
agent_execution_scope: Bind one physical HIB to API, IPMI and UI identities.
Collect complete timestamped redacted Redfish/IPMI records.
Normalize the approved HIB FRU field set.
Compare UI/API/IPMI with Project reference and label stale/missing/encoding differences.
engineer_actions: Approve HIB instance and endpoint/device mapping.
Approve fields, decoding, redaction and authority.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A candidate read only; it assumes identity, weakens TLS and omits IPMI plus complete HIB fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the exact HIB member and mapped IPMI FRU, then compare complete protected evidence with WebUI/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_HIB, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use exact-HIB four-source FRU parity with raw provenance.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor HIB FRU layout/component map and Project build record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic identity, secure complete collection and redaction while retaining source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three API fields do not prove HIB identity or IPMI/WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: HIB mapping, field matrix and authority rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: HIB is vendor-specific and similarly named interconnect boards can yield plausible wrong data.

project_override_considerations: Alternative inventory tooling requires approved exact-HIB binding, per-field equivalence and uncovered original-interface coverage.
expected_evidence: Physical HIB/BMC identity and exact Redfish/IPMI map
Per-field normalized matrix with stale/missing states
Uncleared logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines HIB FRU parity; prior automation incompleteness is external to Source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: HIB FRU validation is understandable; component maps and expected fields are readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid mapping-dependent readiness.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds HIB identity and completeness gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps HIB separate from front-panel and mainboard FRUs.

review_improvement: Requires proof that the management objects refer to the intended HIB before any common manufacturer/product/serial tuple is credited.
independent_technical_reasoning: HIB is a vendor platform role rather than a universal Redfish identity. A syntactically valid resource can represent the wrong interconnect board, so physical relationship and IPMI device mapping are prerequisites to semantic comparison.
